newsitem.title: USA: Vion expands Phase III trial for drug.
newsitem.headline: Vion expands Phase III trial for drug.

text.p: Vion Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday that it had expanded the Phase III clinical trial for its anti-cancer agent, Promycin.
Promycin is now expected to be tested at eight sites in the United States for the treatment of head and neck cancer, Vion said.
The Phase III head and neck cancer trial for 200 patients compares standard radiation therapy to Promycin plus radiation therapy, Vion said.
Promycin is a therapeutic for hypoxic, or oxygen depleted cancer cells, which are known to be less susceptible to radiation therapy than other tumor cells, the company said.

In a Phase I/II clinical trial, the combination of Promycin and radiation therapy produced a 33 percent disease- free survival rate at five years among the participants, who suffered from head and neck cancer, the company said.
